meta.sign: *_out_J: + out of the box (inner fjord, or bay for R1-R3); *_in_J: + into it
meta.flux: Kang & Fringer (2012) on the box faces (budget.kf_budget); F_bc pressure work, A_bc advection; FA_bc = F_bc + A_bc
meta.band_split: exact cospectral split of the time mean (validate.band_flux); band sums = -dt sum over the records
meta.window: 0-T_fin, every record from t = 0; R1k_0_120h: R1k records 0-120 h

F1.method: surface (k = 1) u, v at the T point; one Hann window over the record (spectra.psd); fjord: V2a shelf station and V2b south-coast stations (Task 6 rules); bay: thesis stations (v1_thesis.STATIONS) that are wet

arneborg_liljebladh_band_post_hoc.label: POST HOC descriptive (task-7 rulings, R24): not a verdict
arneborg_liljebladh_band_post_hoc.reference: Arneborg & Liljebladh (2001, JPO 31:2549) Gullmar fjord: net inward baroclinic energy flux at the mouth, band-passed 0.01-0.07 cph

energy.method: time-mean KE_bc (Parseval per band) and exact APE of the inner-fjord box, fields high-passed at 2 df for E_in_hp (H4b(i)); trapped fraction: share of the depth-integrated KE_bc of each band in cells closer than 2 R1 to land (distance = (EDT - 1/2) dx); linear APE is a comparison only
